note: Both sets scramble the wiring-schedule symbol/description pairing, but B gets more of it right (10 = #12/2WG, 33 = 6#10/#10G/1", 151 = AL 3#4/0 armored, 31 = 3/4" conduit) and captures facts A misses entirely, e.g. the 50A/2P main breaker (2P pole count), the NEMA 3R junction box, and the 2-1/2" conduit on the run to the main service panel. A invents wires 11, 104 and 107, misassigns the 3#12 and 3#6 specs to symbols 20 and 50, binds 120/240V and 1-phase to the PV equipment instead of the sub-panel, and reports the main breaker rating as "3 W". B still errs on symbol 50 (calls it CU 3#6/#8G instead of AL 3#4/0/#4G/2-1/2"), repeats A's wrong "Cable 20 = 3#12" claim, reads NEMA 3R as NEMA 3, and attaches a fabricated "200A/2P MAIN BREAKER" quote to the sub-panel, plus several unbound/vague claims ("enclosure", "cable").
